curveconfig.xsd|BusinessDayConvention.name: Business day conventions
curveconfig.xsd|BusinessDayConvention.reason: ORE spells the element BusinessDayConvention, and the set states every rendering ORE's reader accepts and the convention each means. The rule is the element's own name, which the schema states, so every section that declares the leaf takes the same set.

curveconfig.xsd|Currency.name: Currencies
curveconfig.xsd|Currency.reason: ORE spells the element Currency, and a currency is one of the currencies reference data holds. The rule is the element's own name, which the schema states, so every section that declares a Currency leaf takes the same catalogue.

curveconfig.xsd|DayCounter.name: Day counters
curveconfig.xsd|DayCounter.reason: ORE spells the element DayCounter, and the set states every rendering ORE's reader accepts and the day counter each means. The rule is the element's own name, which the schema states, so every section that declares a DayCounter leaf takes the same set.

curveconfig.xsd|YieldCurveDayCounter.name: Day counters
curveconfig.xsd|YieldCurveDayCounter.reason: The yield curve names its day counter with an element of its own, and its values are the renderings ORE's reader accepts for a day counter.
